Our raglan sleeve cashmere cotton collegiate sweatshirt is inspired by the classic 1926 sweatshirt first brought about by footballer Benjamin C. Russell who pioneered the creation of the cotton jersey sweatshirt in order to create an American football training uniform which was more comfortable than its predecessor of the itchy woollen jumper. This was the genesis of what we now know as the iconic Russell Athletic sweatshirt. The sweatshirt became a classic and was adopted widely by students at Ivy League universities in America throughout the 50s and 60s.
